name: Emocii Eviny
source:
The voice was new to my ears but not to my soul. It awakened something long asleep – the calm, clear presence of Self-Sufficiency.

[From [url=https://shmeli-studio.itch.io/evinas-emotions]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个声音对我的耳朵来说很陌生，但对我的灵魂来说却不陌生。它唤醒了沉睡已久的东西——自给自足的平静、清晰的存在。

[来自[url=https://shmeli-studio.itch.io/evinas-emotions]Itch.io[/url]]
